profile.description: Presidential scientific advisory body commissioned to study AI risks by the SIF. External membership alone does not establish federal employment.

summary.text: In April 2024, PCAST recommended that federal funding agencies consider requiring responsible AI use plans from researchers and updating data management plan requirements to disclose AI tools used in proposed research. PCAST also strongly encouraged expanding pilot programs for secure data access and developing federal database management guidelines that incorporate privacy protection technologies. PCAST recommended that the NAIRR pilot be expeditiously expanded to the scale envisioned by the NAIRR Task Force and fully funded. PCAST described AI as having great potential to accelerate science and technology for societal benefit and to help address challenges such as human health and weather prediction.

statements.text: As requested in your landmark Executive Order on the Safe, Secure, and Trustworthy Development and U se of Artificial Intelligence , we are pleased to report here on the possibilities that AI can enable when applied to research to address major societal and global challenges.

attribution.speaker: President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology
attribution.note: Automated extraction; exact quote and attribution span matched the retrieved source.

statements.text: AI will fundamentally transform the way we do science.

attribution.speaker: President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology
attribution.note: Automated extraction; exact quote and attribution span matched the retrieved source.

statements.text: Researchers in many fields are already employing AI to identify new solutions to a wide array of long -standing problems.

attribution.speaker: President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology
attribution.note: Automated extraction; exact quote and attribution span matched the retrieved source.

statements.text: Today, scientists and engineers are using AI to envision, predictively design, and create novel materials and therapeutic drugs.

attribution.speaker: President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology
attribution.note: Automated extraction; exact quote and attribution span matched the retrieved source.

statements.text: PCAST expects that by integrating emerging techniques like these into the chip making process, the U.S. will maintain its position as the leader in semiconductor design while relieving a critical workforce shortage in this area.

attribution.speaker: President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology
attribution.note: Automated extraction; exact quote and attribution span matched the retrieved source.

statements.text: PCAST also expects machine learning models to be able to predict the trajectory of wildfires in real time with high accuracy, saving the lives of both residents and firefighters.

attribution.speaker: President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology
attribution.note: Automated extraction; exact quote and attribution span matched the retrieved source.

statements.text: PCAST believes that AI-powered tools, analyses, and results will fundamentally shift how we explore and understand the very building blocks of life and the composition of those building blocks into living systems with broad applications from agriculture to medicine.

attribution.speaker: President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology
attribution.note: Automated extraction; exact quote and attribution span matched the retrieved source.

statements.text: Scientists are still in the early days of applying AI in social science research, but it is already possible to see that we are entering a tremendously exciting period. PCAST is currently studying the steps the federal government might take to support future advances in the social sciences.

attribution.speaker: President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology
attribution.note: Automated extraction; exact quote and attribution span matched the retrieved source.

statements.text: Ultimately, our vision is that the responsible use of AI will empower scientists and engineers to leverage the opportunities of this transformative technology while navigat ing and mitigat ing its weaknesses.
